title: Chhota Bheem and the Broken Amulet
original_title: छोटा भीम एंड द ब्रोकन आमलेट
overview: When a stranger tries to steal an amulet from the palace, Bheem learns the sad story behind the ornament and heads to Africa to defeat the real villain.

songs.title: Chhota Bheem & Krishna vs Zimbara
songs.singers: Chhota Bheem, Krishna The Great, Sudesh Bhosle, Oushnik Majumdar
